items.tier: primary-text (scriptural narrative; not independently verified historical record)
items.quote: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people:
items.claim: In the text, Moses tells the LORD that the LORD has ordered him to lead ('bring up') the people.
items.action: reports a command received from the LORD

items.tier: primary-text (scriptural narrative; not independently verified historical record)
items.quote: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me.
items.claim: In the text, Moses objects that the LORD has not told him who will be sent with him.
items.action: objects that he has not been told who will accompany him
items.object: the companion or guide to be sent with Moses
items.mechanism: a gap in divine disclosure raised in dialogue

items.tier: primary-text (scriptural narrative; not independently verified historical record)
items.quote: Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
items.claim: In the text, Moses reminds the LORD that the LORD has said he knows Moses by name and that Moses has found favor ('grace') with him.
items.action: cites earlier assurances of personal knowledge and favor
items.mechanism: appeal to an earlier promise to support his request
